name: visualsbyjoshua-build
description: Build tooling for visualsbyjoshua.com. Lives under _private/ so it is never part of the deployed site. Dependencies install OUTSIDE this folder (see optimize-images.mjs) because iCloud sync corrupts node_modules.
comment: sharp is intentionally NOT listed as a dependency. Install it at ~/.visualsbyjoshua-build instead: mkdir -p ~/.visualsbyjoshua-build && cd ~/.visualsbyjoshua-build && npm install sharp@latest
